profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer | Legacy Systems Modernization | Cleared Professional
profile.summary:
With 19 years of experience engineering mission-critical defense systems, I specialize in C# .NET development, complex database architecture (SQL/Oracle), and legacy enterprise modernization.

Currently, I serve as the primary technical authority for a major DoD application portfolio, spearheading its strategic modernization and data integration initiatives. My day-to-day focus involves applying nearly two decades of architectural expertise to engineer secure data pipelines, leverage AI-driven migration tooling, and establish modern data contracts.

Beyond the code, I pride myself on exceptional interpersonal communication. I operate as the bridge between complex engineering concepts and non-technical leadership, ensuring that our architectural designs and data interoperability strategies directly support overarching mission objectives.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Serve as the primary technical authority and architect for the RCAS Force Authorization application family, driving modernization for the US Army Reserve and National Guard.

Enterprise Modernization & Data Integration: Lead the architectural design and data integration strategy for the modernization of a large-scale DoD application portfolio. Currently engineering foundational data pipelines to ensure deep system interoperability and data integrity across classified networks.

Architecture & Stakeholder Alignment: Act as the definitive technical voice for the application suite, conducting high-visibility executive demonstrations and providing decisive feedback that shapes org-level architecture and design patterns.

AI-Driven Engineering Strategy: Pioneer the use of AI-assisted tooling to generate, validate, and execute complex legacy migration plans, significantly accelerating project timelines.

Backend Architecture & Database Migration: Led the strategic decoupling of legacy business logic from Oracle Stored Procedures into a testable, maintainable C# tier using Entity Framework.

positions.title: Creator & Solo Developer
positions.description:
Architected a cloud-native ASP.NET Core 8 MVC application hosted in Azure (App Service, Key Vault) to automate complex scheduling for the Ambassador program.

Engineered a constraint-based, multi-pass scheduling algorithm to optimize shift equity and manage mentor/novice pairings.

Built a robust testing pipeline using xUnit and Playwright for end-to-end automation.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineered enterprise architecture management software (incorporating DoDAF and SysML principles) from the ground up using C# and WPF (MVVM).

Designed complex integrations between proprietary architectural software and external simulation platforms to enable advanced modeling capabilities for defense clients.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected a new .NET 4.0 web application with a Microsoft SQL Server backend for the Warfighter’s Edge department to support US Air Force Academy fighter pilots.

Partnered with Information Assurance (IA) teams to remediate code using HP Fortify, ensuring strict compliance with Air Force network security policies.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed complex satellite tracking applications (WinForms) and graphical user interfaces (GUIs) for government clients, handling real-time orbital data visualization.

Served as Development Lead for commercial contracts, guiding junior developers through Agile sprints.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: Developed automated candidate tracking systems using C# and VB.NET with Oracle backends, ensuring data integrity for high-volume transaction environments.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computers, Networking, Software, Film Studies, Communication
